_notes: Placeholders in angle brackets are filled per repo; install.mjs drops keys whose value still holds an unfilled <placeholder> (it lists them). No secret values live in this file.

steps.<name>: script (a package.json script) OR command (<pm> is replaced by the detected manager, '<pm> exec' by its exec form), timeoutMin, env, kind (lint|typecheck|unit|db|build|e2e|parity|custom), allowEmpty {reason}, approval {reason, approvedBy, approvalRef} (whole step skipped), approvedSkips [{test, reason, issue, approvedBy, approvalRef, approvedAt, recheckBy}].
approvedBy is 'user' or 'orchestrator' quoting a standing user instruction; never the agent that wrote the skip.
Unlisted steps get package.json script resolution (spec section 5). requiredSteps defaults to lint, typecheck, test, db:test, build, e2e.

e2e.buildIdFile + e2e.sourceDirs enable the stale-build check when e2e runs without a build step; jsonReport: true exports PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE (use with a json reporter in the Playwright config or --reporter=list,json in the command).

e2e.serverCommand (starts the app; PORT is exported by gate.mjs and e2e-changed.mjs, install.mjs fills <pm>), specUsers, authRoles[] ({name, loginUrl, statePath?, emailLabel?, passwordLabel?, submitName?, successUrl? (regex string)}), channelOnWindows, healthUrl, buildIdFile and portStart are read by the e2e templates (assets/kit/e2e, found by walking up from the cwd or via E2E_KIT_CONFIG); e2e-changed.mjs also exports PORT, E2E_USE_BUILD and E2E_SERVER_COMMAND.

guard: read by e2e-guard.mjs. baseBranch (default: origin/main, main, origin/master, master), extraTestFiles (globs of shared helpers that hold assertions), assertionHelpers (functions that wrap assertions), approvedDeletions (the only way to approve a deleted test file; the user approves that edit), testIgnore (more globs the suite excludes; Playwright configs are read automatically), dirs and baseline (for --all with a ratchet baseline).

stopGate: read by hooks/stop-gate.mjs. Each of lintChanged, typecheck, relatedTests is true (default command for the detected package manager), false, or a command string with {files} and {pkg} placeholders. packages: workspace dir globs such as apps/* and packages/* (empty = the repo root is the only package). guard: run e2e-guard diff mode first. Never runs e2e, build or db.
Not read by gate.mjs v0.1: stopGate, guard, e2eChanged, authRoles, healthUrl, channelOnWindows.
